info.name: GarnishTable — Uber Eats Marketplace (sandbox)
info.description: Every Uber Eats Marketplace call GarnishTable makes, plus coverage-only checks, with paths, payloads, grants and scopes from Uber's API reference. Use with the 'Uber Eats Sandbox' environment. Secrets live only in secret-type environment variables — never in this file. A collection-level guard blocks every host except Uber's sandbox and localhost.

item.name: 6 · Order retrieval and lifecycle (needs a test order)

request.description: GarnishTable: UberEatsProvider.fetchOrder. Scope eats.order. Place the order in the Uber Eats app signed in as the test developer account, delivering to the test store's address.

exec: pm.test("belongs to the test store", () => pm.expect(b.store && b.store.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get("store_id")));
pm.test("cart items carry the uploaded item id", () => pm.expect(b.cart.items[0].id).to.be.a("string"));

request.description: GarnishTable: UberEatsProvider.acceptOrder. Scope eats.order. Requires this app to be the store's order manager (pos_data is_order_manager).
GarnishTable: UberEatsProvider.denyOrder. Scope eats.order.

Scope eats.store.orders.read. Not used by GarnishTable (it is webhook-driven) — coverage only. Reporting (eats.report) is not implemented and Uber's Request Report reference page currently returns 404, so no reporting request is included.

item.name: 8 · POS provisioning and merchant authorization (needs test store + merchant login)
Merchant login (open in a browser) — authorization_code, eats.pos_provisioning

request.description: GarnishTable: uberEatsConnect.buildAuthorizeUrl (GarnishTable mints a one-time state bound to the signed-in user and verifies it on return). Open in a browser, log in as the TEST STORE's merchant user, copy `code` from the redirect into auth_code. Needs redirect_uri registered on the test app. In Postman/newman this only checks that Uber hands the browser to its login page (302); the redirect URI is validated by Uber after login.
GarnishTable: uberEatsConnect.exchangeCodeForToken.
GarnishTable: uberEatsConnect.discoverStores. User token, eats.pos_provisioning.
GarnishTable: uberEatsConnect.activateStore. Uber's reference lists these as query params but its example sends a body; GarnishTable sends both.
Verification only (GarnishTable doesn't call it).
